outputs.name: shellAdapter
outputs.description: The shell AuditAdapter object for '.sh' files in the 'app', 'dapp' and 'lib' profiles, with id 'shell', label 'Shell' and optional tool 'shellcheck'; its audit(file) method returns the file-length, shebang, strict-mode, unsafe rm -rf, unquoted-variable and curly-function findings for one file. The checks defined in this file are text matches (a '#!' prefix on the first line, a literal 'set -euo pipefail' substring that also matches inside comments, and regular expressions), so they do not parse shell syntax.
